item.title: [New] November 2026 Windows security update is out for every supported Windows and Windows Server, with separate PowerShell fixes for hotpatch devices and no December preview update
item.description:
Patch Tuesday for the whole Windows estate, and on hotpatch devices the PowerShell security fixes are a SEPARATE update offered only after the November hotpatch - a hotpatch ring that installs only the hotpatch stays exposed in PowerShell.

Windows · Deploy the November update through the usual rings; on hotpatch-enrolled Windows 11 and Server 2025 devices confirm KB5135385 / KB5135386 is also installed, and plan for no December preview update.

item.title: [New] Microsoft asks admins to shorten the time from Windows security update release to deployment, because AI speeds up exploit development from published fixes
item.description:
Patch latency is an exposure window an attacker can now close faster; this post is Microsoft's own argument for a shorter deployment ring on Windows endpoints and servers.

Windows · Measure the median days from Patch Tuesday to 95% deployment per ring, and evaluate Autopatch or hotpatch for the rings that miss it.
